parameters.name: DatabaseType
parameters.description:
The type of the database. Valid values:

*   **MYSQL**
*   **MSSQL**
*   **Oracle**

parameters.name: InstanceUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the agent that is used to back up the data of the database.

> You can call the [DescribeUniBackupDatabase](~~DescribeUniBackupDatabase~~) operation to query the UUID.

parameters.name: UniRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the server that hosts the database.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas start-pre-check-database --database-type MYSQL --uni-region-id cn-hongkong --instance-uuid ec1c0ba21d2911ed800000163e0e0000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas StartPreCheckDatabase --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceUuid ec1c0ba21d2911ed800000163e0e0000 --DatabaseType MYSQL --UniRegionId 'cn-hongkong'
